1) systematic review and meta analysis are important tools for summarizing evidence relating to efficacy or effectiveness and safety of health interventions; 2) reporting of systematic reviews in peer-reviewed journals is generally inadequate; 3) the PRISMA Statement provides a 27 item list of items for reporting systematic reviews, with the aim of improving reporting of systematic reviews.
